written: 2026-10-02T09:50Z, after 382 of the 426 protocol cells were measured and before any cell of this addendum
why: Observed in the seed arm (development evidence, 1k screen): for the wide-exponent 6-bit formats under the default recipe on ResNet18 and MobileNetV2 (fp6_e3m2, log6, posit6_es1) every 400-image seed scores 4 to 9 points above the 2000-image calibration. The protocol's bias-only arm covers only int8, posit8_es1, fp8_e4m3fn and int6, so it cannot say whether the range statistics or the bias-correction images cause this. This addendum is a mechanism check, added after seeing the data, and is labelled so in every report.

subsets.R0..R2: range-only: ranges from S_k (k = 0, 1, 2), bias correction from the original first 256 images of the list
subsets.B0..B2: bias-only (as in the protocol): ranges from all 2000 images, bias correction from the first 256 images of S_k

analysis: for each (model, format): mean over k of the range-only and bias-only cells, against the seed mean (S0..S2) and the full-set value; whichever arm reproduces the seed-versus-full difference identifies the source. Reported descriptively, no interval rule.
budget: about 10 GPU-minutes; the protocol's hard stop (3 h summed job time) still applies
